content: iOS WKWebView visibility: WKWebView reports document.visibilityState==='hidden' when the WebView is not visible from the OS point of view (ytyng.com blog, 2026: rAF paused, CSS transitions stop, timers throttled while hidden). performance.now() stops counting on iOS when page sleeps - use Date.now()/getTime() deltas. visibilitychange is NOT reliably delivered in a WebView: the host app must wire onPause/onResume (lyrion-dashboard commit evidence); engine should ALSO listen to window focus and pageshow as resume signals and recompute elapsed hidden time from wall clock. WebKit fires pagehide before visibilitychange (aligned with Chrome/Firefox); visibilitychange:hidden now also fires during navigations (WebKit commit 1a31d8a). No rendering updates occur after hidden - don't rely on hidden-state visual changes.
